ARABIC LANGUAGE — TERMLY EXAM #2
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ARABIC LANGUAGE
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Reading Aloud: Arabic Alphabet, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading Aloud: Arabic Alphabet.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Reading Aloud: Arabic Alphabet.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Reading Aloud: Arabic Alphabet.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Reading Aloud: Arabic Alphabet.

2. When practising Imitative Speaking, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Imitative Speaking.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Imitative Speaking.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Imitative Speaking.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Imitative Speaking.

3. In ARABIC LANGUAGE, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Only memorise without using the language
   B. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day
   C. Mix random languages with no purpose
   D. Avoid speaking to classmates

   C. Use insults to “practise” Phonological Awareness: Fluency.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Phonological Awareness: Fluency.

7. When practising Interactive Speaking, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Interactive Speaking.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Interactive Speaking.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Interactive Speaking.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Interactive Speaking.

8. When practising Conversational Skills, which approach is best? (1 mark)

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
